block-guide:
CORE/COVER A section with a background image (or video, or plain colour) and blocks over it: hero banners, call-to-action strips. The content goes inside wp-block-cover__inner-container as normal blocks. MARKUP (checked in the editor)

Grow with us

Order inside: , then the overlay , then the inner-container
. Unlike core/image, url, id and alt live in the comment as well as on the . OVERLAY (dimRatio) — THE USUAL MISTAKE dimRatio is the overlay's opacity, 0-100, default 100. Leave it out over an image and the overlay is fully opaque (black when no colour is set): the image is hidden. Always write it with an image. Span classes: has-background-dim- (n rounded to tens) + has-background-dim; at exactly 50 only has-background-dim. 0 = no dimming: has-background-dim-0 has-background-dim. Overlay colour: "overlayColor":"" + "isUserOverlayColor":true -> has--background-color first in the span; a custom colour is "customOverlayColor":"#hex" -> style="background-color:#hex" on the span. Colour only, no image: omit url/img; the span then usually has dim 100. OPTIONS Library image: "id" + class wp-image- (and size-) on the gives srcset; an external image: url only, img class just wp-block-cover__image-background. focalPoint {"x":0-1,"y":0-1}: object-position in % in style AND data-object-position on the img. Height: "minHeight":420,"minHeightUnit":"px"|"vh" -> style="min-height:420px" on the div. Or a ratio: "style":{"dimensions":{"aspectRatio":"16/9"}}, no HTML change (applied on render). "isDark":false -> class is-light after the align class: for light images with dark text. contentPosition "top left"…"bottom right" -> has-custom-content-position is-position-top-left. Video: "backgroundType":"video" and . CHECK Open the page: the image is visible through the overlay and the text is readable; reopen the editor: no invalid-content notice.
